Tell us what’s important, and we’ll build the right flows for every practice area and case type. Callers get off the phone feeling heard and ready for next steps.
Personal injury — time-sensitive, high-value
Qualify: Where did the incident occur? Who was at fault? What is the extent of the injuries sustained?
Capture: date of incident; treatment status; insurer contact; current or prior counsel; driver, passenger, or pedestrian.
Convert: book consultation; send retainer agreement. Explore personal injury law solutions
Family law — sensitive, safety-aware
Qualify: What type of case is this regarding? Are any children involved? Which state and county are you located in?
Capture: ages of children; contested or not; opposing party; filing status; assets involved; court date or deadline.
Convert: collect consultation fee; book consultation. Explore family law solutions
Criminal defense — nights and weekends
Qualify: When and where did the arrest occur? What are the charges?
Capture: case type; court date; defendant name; caller name; caller relationship to defendant.
Convert: attempt transfer; book consultation. Explore criminal defense solutions
Estate planning — patient, document-led
Qualify: Are you calling regarding your own documents, or those of a significant other? What type of assets are you looking to protect? What is the estimated value of the estate?
Capture: document type; new or existing; upcoming deadlines; number of dependents.
Convert: book consultation. Explore estate planning solutions
Immigration — bilingual by default
Qualify: Are you or the person you’re calling for currently detained? What is your current immigration status?
Capture: case type; country of citizenship; date entered US; upcoming hearing or deadline; primary language.
Convert: schedule consultation; transfer to firm. Explore immigration law solutions
Employment law — screened against your standard
Qualify: Are you the employer or employee? What is the nature of the employment complaint? Is this related to a protected class?
Capture: proof or documentation; name of employer/company; position/title of employee; salary or hourly wage.
Convert: book consultation; send retainer agreement. Explore employment law solutions

Train — load your procedures, policies, and knowledge base. Key Words ensure the AI understands your industry’s specific terminology — not just generic speech patterns.
Test — LLM-as-a-judge evaluation runs alongside human reviewers. Thousands of synthetic simulations, reviewed by people, build confidence in complexity before deployment.
Deploy — every call with your AI receptionist feeds the system. Voice quality, transcription accuracy, and conversational UX are monitored in real time.
Analyze & improve — CSAT signals, unanswered FAQs, and quality trends are processed automatically and reviewed by humans, then fed back into Train.
Quality is our moat. Humans are our unfair advantage. Our system trains, tests, deploys, and improves in parallel, around the clock, with humans in the loop at every stage.

Questions firms ask us first
Can Smith.ai replace my intake staff?

Most firms use Smith.ai to supplement their intake staff, so teams can spend more time on the relational client work once qualified leads are retained. We’re here to empower legal teams to get back to the work they’re meant to do, with fewer interruptions.
Do the receptionists give legal advice?
No. Our receptionists never give legal advice. They are trained to feel like an extension of your firm, but legal advice is left to the attorneys and legal team.
Can Smith.ai turn away matters we don’t take?

Yes. Out-of-practice-area callers are identified during qualification and, per your instructions, can be referred to a bar association or another firm, so your team only spends time on valuable conversations.
Will my callers know they’re talking to AI?

Yes, you can customize your AI Receptionist to follow your firm’s bar rules and disclosure preferences, and it never claims to be human when a caller asks directly. With Virtual Receptionist, every call is answered by a real, live agent from the start.
What happens when the AI can’t handle a call?
For complex calls, our AI seamlessly hands off to a human receptionist from our Live Agent Network, so the caller reaches a real person instead of a dead end.
Who decides what gets asked on the call?

We do the heavy lifting. Smith.ai’s call flows are built from patterns refined across 25M+ calls and more than a decade of legal intake, so your firm starts with a system already shaped by what converts, not a blank script. Our playbooks are customizable, so flows can be further tailored to your firm’s established intake flow.
Can you run conflict checks?
Our live agents can check callers against your existing contacts and matters during qualification.
What happens to confidential caller information?
Call data is encrypted and stored within the dashboard, protected by your logged-in credentials, to protect your privacy and confidentiality. Call recordings are deleted after three months.
What if the receptionists get something wrong?

Built-in oversight is part of our system. Every call runs through our Quality Flywheel (train, test, deploy, improve), and if something needs to be corrected on your setup, our world-class CS team can ensure it’s optimized going forward.
How much work is this to set up on our end?
Setup depends on the complexity of your firm’s needs, but our years of intake expertise make the process smooth. Most law firms are up and running in a few days.
What does this cost, and what am I actually paying for?

AI Receptionist runs about $1–2 per call, Virtual Receptionist about $6–10 per call, and Hybrid about $2–5 per call. You pay per call, not per minute, so a long new-client call costs the same as a short one.
Can you integrate with my practice management system?
Yes. We integrate natively with Clio, MyCase, Lawmatics, Filevine, and 7,000+ other tools — updating contact records, logging every call as CRM activity, and pulling case status in real time.
Can Smith.ai receptionists book consultations, or do they just take a message?
Both. We’ll take a message if that’s what your firm wants, but we can also book consultations directly on your calendar the moment a caller qualifies, so nothing waits on a callback.
Is it okay for a service outside our firm to handle end-to-end intake?

Yes, with the same oversight any firm applies to nonlawyer intake staff. Under ABA Rule 5.3, a supervising attorney is expected to confirm any outsourced intake service acts consistently with the firm’s professional obligations, which is why our playbooks are built to your firm’s needs rather than open-ended. (General awareness, not legal advice, since state bar rules vary.)
Can you complete my intake forms?

Yes. Your firm’s specific intake fields and qualifying questions can be built into every onboarding call, so all the information you need lands directly in your practice management system, already organized.
Can you reschedule my appointments?
Yes, appointment management works both ways. If a client needs to reschedule a consultation, we can do so directly on your calendar, just as we book.
Can you make outbound calls?

On Virtual Receptionist plans, our live agents place outbound calls to confirm appointments, return missed calls, follow up on leads, or relay time-sensitive updates. If follow-up calls matter to your firm, ask about Virtual Receptionist plans or Hybrid plans rather than AI Receptionist alone.
